note: Forbidden: a Hello whose E, N or DC bit does not follow the area type or the wish to suppress Hellos. TestRFC5340HelloOptionsBits sends Hellos through the real send path and asserts E set and N clear for a regular area, N set and E clear for NSSA, both clear for stub (both directions of each 'if and only if'), and DC zero in all three; ze has no demand-circuit support and never wishes to suppress Hellos, so DC clear is the only correct value.
